accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

blp_slot_active_registration_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the call

supplied_slot_readable_and_active_verifi.meaning: the supplied slot was verified readable and active before notifyVaultSupply was called

total_backing_signed_reverts_observed.meaning: a later totalBackingSigned()/distributableSurplus()/settleDailyPnL() read reverts while the stale supplied entry remains registered
total_backing_signed_reverts_observed.checkpoint: after registration, before removeSuppliedEntry clears it

assumptions: The notifyVaultSupply call is the checked action; the reverting reads occur later while the stale entry remains registered.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a deterministic trigger for HyperCore leaving the 0x811 slot inactive; the reverting-read outcome is only potential.
Timing of the later reverting reads relative to registration is not quantified.

limitations: The three reverting functions are treated as one outcome per the frozen impact statement.
The potential modality of the impact is preserved only via the impact_context_terms witness; the required_effect template expresses the desired non-revert relation.
